text:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate and latency spike detected for service=redwood-api in us-west-2 (az: usw2b). ELB 5xx surge + Route53 resolution latency increase. Auto-escalating to #incidents. Details: rollup_errors=12x, p95 latency 2.8s, dropped connections increasing.

mike_sre: acknowledging, joining. grabbing logs and load metrics now.

ops_oncall: paged. seeing ELB targetgroup healthchecks failing intermittently, a lot of CONNRESET from targets. Possible ENI saturation in usw2b? Cloudwatch shows high NetworkOut and connection drops on several EC2 instances in that AZ.

ben_platform: thanks. can we get a quick customer impact blurb for page? irene_support - any external reports?

irene_support: multiple customers reporting elevated 502s and streaming disconnects. Top affected tenants: billing-service integrations and mobile SDKs in NA-west. SLA alerts triggered for 3 customers (tentative).

ops_oncall: initial mitigation plan: 1) divert traffic away from affected AZ (adjust ELB AZ routing) 2) bump Route53 health-check weights to favor other AZs and reduce TTLs to 30s for faster failover 3) if needed, shift critical DNS record to us-west-1 as failover. Can someone run the route53 change?

sarah_sre: I'm on it. creating change batch now. using secondary fallback policy we have for cross-region failover.

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline: rollback of recent infra change in us-west-2 was queued by mike_sre. Approval required: ben_platform.

mike_sre: I requested rollback because there was an ENI provisioning tweak merged earlier today. It coincides with the onset of errors, low risk to roll back.

ben_platform: approved. go for rollback. mike_sre, coordinate with sarah and ops_oncall before traffic shift.

sarah_sre: applying Route53 change now (low TTL). change-id: C4Z72EXAMPLE. Command used:

```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123EXAMPLE --change-batch file://usw2-failover-weights.json
```

usw2-failover-weights.json snippet:

```
{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.example.com","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"usw2-weighted","Weight":10,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"Z2P70J7EXAMPLE","DNSName":"dualstack-alb-usw2.example.com.","EvaluateTargetHealth":false}}}]}
```

ops_oncall: lowering Route53 TTL to 30s for relevant records:

```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z123EXAMPLE --change-batch file://lower-ttl.json
```
deploy-bot: Rollback job started: infra/eni-setup revert -> job 8892. Estimated duration 4m.

mike_sre: monitoring ELB target health and instance metrics. also increasing ALB connection draining to 120s while shifting.

incident-bot: NOTE: On-call handoff scheduled in 35m. Current on-call: ops_oncall -> next: ben_platform. Addhand-off channel: @ben_platform.

customer-signal-bot: Received 14 new user impact reports in the last 10 minutes. Severity: P2. Examples: 502 errors from /generate and timeout >10s on long-polling.

irene_support: sending proactive message to affected customers: initial note that we're investigating routing issues in us-west-2 and may perform a traffic shift. ETA unknown. Will update in 15.

sarah_sre: Rollback completed at 2456789120, infra change reverted. ALB metrics show reduction in connection errors but target health still flapping in usw2b. Proceeding with DNS weight shift to reduce traffic to affected AZ to 0 for now. change-id: C4Z72EXAMPLE-2.

ops_oncall: issuing ELB AZ deregistration for instances in usw2b (gradual drain):

```
aws elbv2 set-subnets --load-balancer-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/api-alb/abcdef --subnets subnet-aaa,subnet-ccc
```

note: doing this carefully to avoid capacity shock.

mike_sre: Observed drop in 5xxs after removing AZ from LB and adjusting weights. error rate down from 12x to ~1.4x baseline over 8 minutes. Latency p95 improved to 420ms.

ben_platform: good. prepare postmortem stub. assign owners: networking: sarah_sre, infra: mike_sre, customer comms: irene_support.

ops_oncall: open todo: 1) replace/inspect ENIs in usw2b 2) run targeted instance reboots and monitor conntrack 3) check EBS I/O stats (no obvious EBS degradation yet) 4) follow up with AWS support case (opened #1234567890) 5) evaluate long-term plan to increase cross-AZ capacity.

sarah_sre: AWS support inbound: case #1234567890 — attaching packet capture and instance metrics. AWS advises ENI resource pressure is possible; they're investigating fabric-level telemetry for the AZ.

incident-bot: Reminder: if outage persists beyond 60 minutes escalate to SEV2 war room.

irene_support: Update to customers sent at 2456789400: "We're routing traffic away from an affected AZ in us-west-2 and performing mitigations. You may see reduced latency and fewer errors as the traffic shifts. We'll update when AWS confirms root cause."

mike_sre: For followup, saving snapshots of affected instances and collecting conntrack tables:

```
sudo conntrack -L > /var/log/conntrack-245678.log
aws ec2 create-snapshot --volume-id vol-0example --description "post-incident-snapshot"
```

ops_oncall: last check: error rate stable at ~1.2x and trending down. Route53 propagation showing most clients now resolving to us-west-1/us-west-2 other AZs. Will keep the weights at reduced level for 2 hours then gradually restore.

ben_platform: planning retrospective tomorrow 10:00 PT. include runbook updates for faster AZ isolation and DNS failover. Also consider reducing default TTLs for critical records during deploy windows.

sarah_sre: AWS follow-up: they confirmed a networking fabric anomaly affecting ENI provisioning and intra-AZ packet drops in usw2b. AWS to provide RCA. We'll coordinate with customers for any residual impact.

irene_support: final customer update at 2456789700: "Issue mitigated — traffic rerouted and abnormal errors reduced. We will provide a full postmortem when available. If you still see issues, please reply and we'll prioritize." :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: auto-close scheduled in 2h unless new alerts. Tagged sev: sev3->was escalating but mitigated.

mike_sre: thumbs. I'll start drafting the postmortem with timeline and commands used. Adding notes about potential improvement: better per-AZ connection quotas, automated weighted DNS failover playbook.

ops_oncall: handing off active monitoring to ben_platform in 25m. ben, please take over and watch for regression.

ben_platform: taking handoff. watching dashboards. thanks team. :pray:
